subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should Codex app-server `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` formally bound WebSocket and Unix upgrade handshakes as well as control-plane RPC work?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and uses an existing setting, but it intentionally changes failure timing for existing remote and Unix transports; that shared operator contract needs owner acceptance rather than an automated choice.

options.title: Approve shared timeout contract
options.body: Accept `requestTimeoutMs` as the single ceiling for app-server RPC and upgrade handshakes, then merge after current-head checks pass.

options.title: Introduce a separate handshake policy
options.body: Keep the existing RPC-only meaning and design a separately documented setting or fixed policy for transport upgrades.

options.title: Pause for Codex contract review
options.body: Hold the PR if the owner wants broader transport-timeout semantics evaluated across Codex connection modes first.

recommendation.title: Approve shared timeout contract
recommendation.body: Accept `requestTimeoutMs` as the single ceiling for app-server RPC and upgrade handshakes, then merge after current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The review context calls for Codex-owner acceptance but does not provide enough reliable history to name an individual owner.
